description: Delete an AutoMod rule; its protection stops immediately. Safe to call directly: the first call changes nothing and returns a preview plus a confirm_token; repeating the call with the token deletes it. Turning it off with update_automod_rule is the reversible alternative.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

name: delete_automod_rule
title: Delete AutoMod rule
